<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=The Neighbor|id=A0027}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Yes, there is something for everyone: Here comes the anti-social dialogue! On the other hand, talking about neighbors is a pretty social activity, isn't it? In any case, the keyword is: '''tampoco''' – not either.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0004|A0004: She's not Mexican]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0030|A0030: Call back later]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0072|A0072: Here is my card]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Ahí viene el vecino.'''
| Here comes the neighbor.
| '''¿Lo conoces?'''
| Do you know him?
| '''No, no lo conozco. ¿Y tú?'''
| No, I don't know him. How about you?
| '''Tampoco.'''
| Me neither.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Ahí viene el vecino.'''
| Here comes the neighbor.
| '''¿Lo conoces?'''
| Do you know him?
| '''No, no lo conozco. ¿Y tú?'''
| No, I don't know him. How about you?
| '''Tampoco.'''
| Me neither.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| Here comes the neighbor.
| '''Ahí viene el vecino.'''
| Do you know him?
| '''¿Lo conoces?'''
| No, I don't know him. How about you?
| '''No, no lo conozco. ¿Y tú?'''
| Me neither.
| '''(Yo) tampoco.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Here comes the neighbor.
| '''Ahí viene el vecino.'''
| Do you know him?
| '''¿Lo conoces?'''
| No, I don't know him. How about you?
| '''No, no lo conozco. ¿Y tú?'''
| Me neither.
| '''(Yo) tampoco.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| There the neighbor comes.
| '''Ahí el vecino viene.'''
| I don't know him. Do you know him?
| '''No lo conozco. ¿Lo conoces?'''
| I don't know him either. 
| '''No lo conozco tampoco.'''
| And the (female) neighbor? 
| '''¿Y la vecina?'''
| I don't know her. What about you?
| '''No la conozco. ¿Y tú?
| Neither do I know her.
| '''Yo tampoco la conozco.''' 
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| There the neighbor comes.
| '''Ahí el vecino viene.'''
| I don't know him. Do you know him?
| '''No lo conozco. ¿Lo conoces?'''
| I don't know him either. 
| '''No lo conozco tampoco.'''
| And the (female) neighbor? 
| '''¿Y la vecina?'''
| I don't know her. What about you?
| '''No la conozco. ¿Y tú?
| Neither do I know her.
| '''Yo tampoco la conozco.''' 
}}</includeonly>
